scope: Images from Performing the What-If and related embodied, performance, workshop, and teaching practice. Individual captions establish context; inclusion does not imply card-deck use in every example.
processing: Web copies preserve the full frame and aspect ratio, with no enlargement. Photographs have a maximum side of 1600 pixels; the text-heavy framework table retains native dimensions. Original source files are retained separately.
